name: Guillena (Spain)
description: Vertical tricolour of blue, white and blue with a broad white stripe, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Guillena (a castle between trees on red above waves).
history: Municipal flag of Guillena; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Guillena arms — castle between trees on red above waves
castle and crown of the arms
